## Body

Test crash points together with destination changes, not independently. In #279, atomic SQLite holding ends/starts fixed the split-index gap, and A->B->C before carry began passed. But after governance committed A->B and before its index transaction, cancellation plus B->C stranded the request: redo targeting C skipped A because its release reason named B; B had no indexed holding, so its intent had no role scope. Recovery must reconstruct the intermediate governance owner, not merely follow the latest seat chain.

F233 retained this RED at head 31bd3c9; the prime accepted shipping it. Accepted risk is not a healed regression. Reviewer verdict d547a1d0 records no other blocker. Open the portable fixture and scrubbed receipt in the standing governance worktree: .harness/records/retro/2026-11-20/review-279-r2-overlap.diff and review-279-r2-overlap.log. Recheck subsequent F233 closure before treating the behavior as current.
